title: Vital Signs and Pain During Insertion of IUD
brief_summary: Cross-sectional cohort study to evaluating pain and vital signs variations (blood pressure and radial pulse) during the placement of the intrauterine device.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age older than 18 years
* cytology without abnormalities
* classification for Category 1 or 2 of the WHO eligibility criteria for IUD / IUS.

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with cardiac arrhythmias
* gynecological disorders
study_population: Women that attended to clinical visit to insertion of IUD
